title: coax has its own output style in a Claude profile used only by coax
body:
The Claude entry in `~/.config/coax/config.toml` runs with Jack's normal Claude config, so its replies follow his Dense output style. Dense was written for Claude Code's own renderer, down to its yaml-fence coloring.

## Proposal

- A Claude Code output style written for coax and for what coax's markdown renderer draws (see the issue on rendering agent text).
- The style lives in a Claude config folder used only by coax. The coax entry selects it with `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` in its `env`.

## Rejected

- Text that coax sends when it opens a session, which the adapter appends to the system prompt. Jack wants a real output style, so that it is enforced the same way through long sessions and compaction. A real output style also avoids two styles fighting, Dense plus coax's added text.
- Setting the style in `~/.claude/settings.json`. That changes Claude Code too.

## Open

- A second config folder needs its own login and its own copy or link of settings, skills and `CLAUDE.md`. Jack wants a tool to manage Claude profiles. Whether it is built first, and where it lives, is still undecided.
close_reason: The coax output style is written and runs from the trial profile, with `outputStyle` set to `Coax` (see the notes). The move into a profile of its own is guise-5d4990 in guise's tracker, waiting on guise's `create`.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/4d38e22a
notes.text: The profile tool is its own project, `guise` in `../guise`, with its design in guise-2407d6. Jack plans to build it later. Until then the Claude entry runs on his normal `~/.claude`.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/4d38e22a
notes.text: The trial runs from the `claude-coax` entry in `~/.config/coax/config.toml`, with `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` pointing at `tmp-claude/2026-11-08-coax-style/claude-config`. That folder links `CLAUDE.md` and `skills/` from `~/.claude`, copies `settings.json` with `outputStyle` set to Coax, and holds the style in `output-styles/coax.md`. Its plugins folder is missing, so enabled plugins may not load there.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/4d38e22a
notes.text: A revised style is drafted as `output-styles/coax-next.md` in the same profile folder, beside the active `coax.md`. It describes the bordered boxes, scroll bars and copy buttons, and teaches the link forms coax now draws (7a387c5): `file:` for code locations, `foam:` for issues, web links, and `color:` for status words. To try it, set `outputStyle` to `Coax next` in that folder's `settings.json`. The scheme names and the wording are Jack's to review.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/bd10c4a0
notes.text: Jack approved the revised draft. It replaced `output-styles/coax.md` in the trial profile, with the commands section from coax-5e39b9 added, and `coax-next.md` is gone. `outputStyle` stays `Coax`, so the next session runs it. The profile still lives under `tmp-claude/` until guise can hold it.
